_meta.description: Null-state survey on the nullable income field of intake.pulse via AGG_NULL_COUNT paired with AGG_COUNT (present values) for a complete present-vs-null contrast. AGG_NULL_COUNT reads the per-record null bitmap (Schema.HasBitmap()), so a blank income counts as missing, never as zero: about a quarter of the forms leave income blank.
_meta.name: null_count_contrast
